Innolitics | https://innolitics.com/join | Remote | Full-Time

Innolitics' is helps bring AI-enabled regulated medical software onto the US market. We focus on righting high-quality, clearly documented code and helping our clients with regulatory submissions. We care about safety and cybersecurity.

We're an organized, established team and have been in business 15 years, helping 100s of companies onto the market in radiology, cardiology, neurology, and other fields.

Principal Medical Device Software Engineer - $200,000–$250,000/year + 10-12% bonus. Required 15+ years experience as a software engineer and 8+ years of experience in the medical device space.

Staff Medical Device Software Engineer - $170,000–$200,000/year + 10-12% bonus. Requires 10+ years experience as a software engineer and experience going through at least one 510(k) or De Novo.
